hypotheses.explanation: Convert calls take 96 ms and 74 ms client-side while corresponding server spans take under 1 ms. Repeated latency outside server execution suggests transport delay contributing to frontend response times; network causation is not confirmed.

Two recommendation calls take 85 ms and 79 ms client-side versus approximately 4 ms server-side. Metrics corroborate the client/server duration gap, suggesting transport delay on the cart-page dependency path.

Charge takes 92 ms client-side but only 1.9 ms server-side. Payment completes successfully well before checkout records completion, and aggregate metrics show the same gap, suggesting transport delay rather than payment-processing failure.
